caption: The drawing consists of a square composition centered on a plain, off-white background. The square is defined by three borders: the innermost border is thin and white; the next border is thicker and dark blue with small white diamond patterns evenly spaced across it; the outermost border is similar in design to the second, also dark blue with white diamond patterns. Inside the innermost border, the central area contains an interlocking geometric pattern in two shades of blue, with shapes resembling curved arrows or leaves that repeat and tile the space. The blue shapes are filled with a lighter blue, while the background of the pattern is the same off-white as the rest of the drawing. The composition is entirely geometric and symmetrical, with no representational or figurative elements.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
